study: conservative near-gap mask vs unmodified BLS; motivated by uploaded Hatzes/ Springer and Robnik 2026
git_condition: All hyperparameters in this file and the code must stay unchanged throughout the first evaluation; changes after observing outcomes are development-only and need a new test
data_policy: Official NASA MAST Q2 or Q8 PDCSAP long-cadence FITS, quality == 0, finite positive flux; injection before 301-cadence running-median detrend.

calibration_stars.selection: Previously used as measured Kepler variability control; calibration only
Preselected variable star for proxy-null calibration; actual planet-free status not assumed

heldout_stars.selection: Kepler-10 host selected for independent held-out stress testing; original transits possible
Published seismic Kepler star; held out from preprocessing selection

null_proxy.name: inverted_flux_with_random_index_roll
null_proxy.warning: Proxy nulls are NOT guaranteed planet-free Kepler stars nor realistic DR25 instrumental false alarms. Rolling inverted flux may alter gap alignment, so measured flag fractions only describe this constructed control distribution.

decision.inequality: BLS score strictly greater than chosen method-specific threshold
decision.threshold_method: higher empirical quantile on calibration-star proxy nulls
decision.metric: correct period within 2 percent AND above method-specific proxy threshold
decision.type: Exploratory first external run. This does not replicate Robnik 2026 pixel-level injections or true Kepler survey FAP.

generalization: Preselect source cohort; preserve all failed files and test cases, report small sample/Wilson intervals. Not an independent guarantee of planet discovery.
